events.title: How AI (helped) Built A 6 Figure Business
events.description:
AI didn't build this business. It helped, and this talk is about what that help actually looked like.

Alec walks through the full history of a real product built on Azure, .NET, and Angular, from the first idea to six figures in revenue. He covers where AI saved weeks, where it made confident mistakes that had to be torn out by hand, and the development workflow.

You'll leave with:

• An honest picture of where AI speeds up building a product and where it slows you down
• A workflow you can apply to your own .NET and Angular projects
• A view of how AI-assisted development is changing for small teams shipping real products

Speaker bio

Alec Harrison is a Staff AI Engineer at LeanTECHniques, where he builds production RAG systems, Semantic Kernel agent workflows, Model Context Protocol integrations, and Azure AI Foundry solutions. He is a Microsoft MVP in AI and a Microsoft Certified Trainer, and he teaches the generative AI section of LinkedIn Learning's AI-102 course. Alec leads Azure user groups in Iowa, Omaha, and Kansas City, which together reach more than 4,000 engineers. He also runs Xerikos, a consulting practice focused on AI, cloud, and governance, and maintains Offline Assist, an open-source AI coding assistant for VS Code.

events.title: Architecting AI-Ready Enterprises on Azure
events.description:
Summary:

AI features are easy to demo. AI systems are hard to trust.

Most enterprises aren't struggling to find AI use cases — they're struggling to build the foundation that makes those use cases safe to ship, scalable, and defensible when something goes wrong.

In this session, we'll examine the architectural decisions that make an enterprise AI-ready on Azure: governance patterns using Azure AI Foundry and managed identity, integration strategies that keep AI capabilities inside your security boundary, and the operational model you need before you put an LLM anywhere near production data.

You'll leave with a concrete framework for making Azure AI architectural decisions that hold up under pressure — not just under a deadline.

You will learn:
\- How to evaluate Azure AI governance patterns including Azure AI Foundry\, managed identity\, and private endpoints for securing AI workloads in production
\- How to design integration architectures that embed AI capabilities into existing enterprise systems without creating shadow infrastructure or security gaps
\- How to build an operational framework for auditing\, monitoring\, and scaling Azure\-based AI systems across the enterprise

Bio:

Tony Champion is a software architect with 25+ years of experience on the Microsoft stack, specializing in modern APIs, distributed systems, and cross-platform architecture. An eight-time Microsoft MVP, published author and international speaker, he focuses on practical, production-ready solutions and helping developers think and operate at a senior, architectural level.
